newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: SUGAR STOCK SLIGHTLY EASES INDEX AT MAURITIUS BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: SUGAR STOCK SLIGHTLY EASES INDEX AT MAURITIUS BOURSE.

text.p: The index at the Mauritius Stock Exchange eased slightly on Friday, driven down by a loss in sugar-based blue chip MTMD, bourse officials said.
They said the index lost 0.41 points to 363.85 while volume traded rose to 8.57 million rupees on 279,766 shares from 6.79 million rupees on 255,082 shares on Wednesday.
Brokers said subdued market sentiment was still prevailing as foreign investors were not seen active on stocks in the banking sector.
"The stock market is following a general feeling of uncertainty over the political outlook as national assembly members are on holiday presently and will resume on late October," one broker said.
Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) lost 50 cents to 38.00 rupees on 66,368 shares, Harel Freres was stable at 51.00 rupees on 6,000 shares and Savannah (O) rose 2.00 rupees to 136.00 rupee s on 410 shares.
Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) remained to 86.50 rupees on 2,204 shares and State bank of Mauritius (SBM) was unchanged to 12.00 rupees on 53,400 shares.

New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) was stable at 36.80 rupees on 71,046 shares, Sun Resorts also was unchanged to 45.00 rupees on 5,700 shares and Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) remained to 50.00 rupees on 2,000 shares.

In the commerce sector, conglomerates Rogers edged 50 cents to 90.50 rupees on 2,019 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) climbed 10 cents to 15.50 rupees on 21,659 shares. Happy World Foods (HWF) climbed 10 cents to 14.60 rupees on 205 shares.

Investment stock Fincorp was 2.50 rupees lower to 59.50 rupees on 360 shares, United Docks gained 20 cents to 36.00 rupees on 2,000 shares and Mauritius Development Investment Trust (MDIT) was stable at 6.45 rupees on 20,000 shares. Air Mauritius edged 10 cents to 31.30 rupees, but was not quoted.
